## Dracula

A dark theme inspired by the iconic Dracula color scheme for code editors. Deep navy backgrounds with vivid purple accents create a distinctive, atmospheric admin interface.

### Highlights

- **Dark only** — single variant, no mode switching needed
- **Purple accent (#bd93f9)** for a signature Dracula feel
- **Full Dracula palette** — cyan, green, orange, pink, red, and yellow all mapped to semantic roles
- **System fonts** — no custom font download required

### Usage

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/dracula.css">
```
